SSC GD Constable Vacancy 2026 – 25487 पदों पर भर्ती | Online Form - Complete Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) ने SSC GD Constable Vacancy 2026 के लिए आधिकारिक नोटिफिकेशन जारी कर दिया है। देश भर के 10वीं पास युवाओं के लिए यह सरकारी

Important Dates

  • अंतिम तिथि (Last Date) : 31/12/2025
  • करेक्शन डेट (Correction Date) : 8 जनवरी 2026

Application Fee

  • अंतिम तिथि (Last Date) : 31/12/2025
  • General / OBC / EWS : ₹ 100/-
  • SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen : ₹ 0/- (Nil)
  • Chest : 80-85 CMS

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
